text: 64yo male admitted with chest tightness and dizziness. Past medical history: Atrial Fibrillation, Hypertension. Allergies: Penicillin (Severe Anaphylaxis). Home Meds: Warfarin 5mg once daily, Lisinopril 10mg daily.
Hemoglobin: 8.1 g/dL (LOW). INR: 4.8 (CRITICAL HIGH). Stool occult blood: POSITIVE.
Patient developed upper GI bleed secondary to supratherapeutic INR. DISCONTINUED Warfarin immediately. Started IV pantoprazole. Also noted mild productive cough; suspect early bronchitis.
Patient stabilized and ready for discharge. Resume home medications: Warfarin 5mg once daily, Lisinopril 10mg daily. Added Amoxicillin 500mg TID for 5 days for bronchitis.
